plan.objective: Improve already-known spread<=0.9 model so full-history stressed net stays positive while retaining EUR100-200 successful trades

hypotheses.baseline: Original 1R activation / 1R trailing gap and M1 confirmation
hypotheses.trail_gap_1_25: Original 1R activation, trailing gap 1.25R; existing SL can only improve
hypotheses.fresh_confirmation: Setup expiry 3 M30 bars instead of 5

plan.fixed: EUR20,000 starting balance, 0.5% risk per entry, 0.5 max lot, 20-pip initial SL and 2R initial TP; spread cap 0.9; original daily/portfolio guards, sessions, cooldown and single-position rule. No martingale/averaging or widening existing stops.
plan.selection: Nominate highest net in earlier-year doubled-cost replay only; tie lower M1-close equity drawdown, then name. Lock before later or full-history replays. Report every hypothesis including rejected nominees; no parameter amendment after outcomes.
plan.success_measure: Nominee full-history base AND doubled-cost net positive, mean net winner EUR100-200 and at least one winning trade in that band in each scenario; later doubled-cost net also positive with mean winner EUR100-200. Counts and all other outcomes disclosed. Descriptive historical criterion, not live approval.
plan.accounting: Each window is a separate continuous EUR20k account, no monthly resets. Full window carries equity/positions across both years. Drawdown includes open P&L at observed M1 closes and incurred entry commission, with actual simulated fills on exits.
limitations: These dates were examined repeatedly in prior research. This is exploratory improvement on reused history; positivity does not prove future profitability.
Only earlier-year stress selects the fixed nominee. The full-history comparison includes selection data and is descriptive, not an untouched holdout.
Historical spreads, assumed commissions/slippage and constant symbol valuation. Swap/overnight financing, latency, historical margin/minimum-stop constraints and full tick paths are not modeled.
Doubled costs means EUR7.00/lot/side commission and 0.4-pip adverse market/stop slippage instead of EUR3.50/0.2 pip. Observed spread is unchanged; missing-spread fallback doubles from 1 to 2 pips.
M1-close drawdown can be smaller than intrabar drawdown. Daily loss guard is a trigger, not a guaranteed loss bound.
Mean winning trade excludes losses; net for all trades, count in target band and mean losing trade are disclosed. No promise that every successful trade earns EUR100-200.
